item.title: The oracle given to Eulaos #1792 seemed to have failed: "Wooden walls alone will stand, wh
item.description: The oracle given to Eulaos #1792 seemed to have failed: "Wooden walls alone will stand, when the spears of Iolcus are counted." Then the priests explained that it had meant the stone in Field of Ares all along. Everyone agreed it was obvious.
